The '''Ornamental Hay Bale''' is a piece of decorative [[furniture]] that can be purchased from [[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|250}}, any day that [[Marnie]] is tending the shop.

It can be placed anywhere, indoors or out.  

==Trivia==
Hay Bales can be seen on display outside [[Marnie's Ranch]].
